Sunny Deol and Akshaye Khanna star in new courtroom drama 'Ikka', trailer released

The trailer for the upcoming Indian film 'Ikka' has been released, featuring Sunny Deol as a top lawyer and Akshaye Khanna as his difficult client. The movie is directed by Siddharth P. Malhotra and also stars Tillotama Shome and Dia Mirza in key roles. The film's release date has not been announced yet.
